epics.title: Frontend Build and Serving Integration
epics.jtbd: When the end customer accesses the deployed application, I want to see the actual user interface rather than a bare API, so that I can interact with the product visually.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce the percentage of deployed instances serving a bare API instead of the UI from 100% to 0%.
requirements: R1: The Dockerfile must build the frontend using npm ci and npm run build.
R2: The built static output must be served by the backend at the root path.

slices.title: Configure Docker and Backend for Frontend Serving
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Docker and backend changes for this epic, I want to build the frontend and serve its static output, so that the deployed image presents a functional UI to the user.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a deployed instance built from the updated Dockerfile,
When a user accesses the root path of the backend service,
Then the built static frontend application is successfully served,
And an automated test verifies that the HTTP response contains the valid frontend HTML.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the number of build configuration errors preventing frontend serving from 1 to 0.

epics.title: HTML Mockup Generation Fix
epics.jtbd: When the end customer uses the application, I want the interface to be built from correctly generated HTML mockups, so that the application provides a functional and usable design.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the success rate of the design generator producing implementable mockup.html files from 0% to 100%.
requirements: R1: The design generator configuration must be updated to output an implementable mockup.html instead of an image asset.

slices.title: Update Design Generator Output Format
slices.jtbd: When implementing the design generator fix for this epic, I want to adjust the AI model configuration, so that it successfully generates implementable HTML mockups instead of images.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the design generation tooling configuration,
When the design generator is triggered to create a mockup,
Then the system outputs a valid mockup.html file instead of an image asset,
And the generated artifact passes a syntax check confirming it is implementable HTML.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the proportion of generated mockups containing valid HTML from 0% to 100%.
